name: NYDFS Part 500 Annual Certification — Countersigned
outcome: Binds the site's NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 annual Certification of Material Compliance (repo/tools/570-nydfs-part500-certification-builder.html — a chainless browser tool, no OCG kernel) to a §27.3 maker-checker countersignature_slot via the §3.1 attested-artifact binding path: the CISO/compliance maker signs the exact certification bundle produced, a checker performs the §3.3 Tier-B binding-integrity verification (digests recompute, NOT a re-run of the tool), and the senior-officer acceptance node holds under dual_control(2) until two distinct identities have recorded — the annual Apr 15 certification's countersignature_slot showcase.
